primary_call_site.behavior: After AsyncStorage.setItem('v101_selected_server_id', s.server_id) and before router.replace('/(tabs)/home'), the UI calls POST /api/psp/ensure?server_id=<sid> with explicit Bearer token (v96_auth_token from SecureStore). Idempotent: backend Pack 85 returns already_exists_no_write if PSP exists. NO silent 's1'. NO global fallback on failure. NO copy S1->S2. Best-effort UX: on failure lobby downstream shows honest blocker.

defensive_call_site.behavior: If lobby opens with selectedServerId and Bearer token available, calls POST /api/psp/ensure?server_id=<sid> as defensive guard for deep-link / hot-reload / direct navigation paths that bypass servers.tsx. Idempotent. Same NO-fallback and NO-copy invariants.
